General Information
Reservations-May be made at all ticket offices herein listed and at all
Western Union and Postal Telegraph offices.
Reservations over connecting
lines will be made if sufficient time is allowed.
Cancellations-Company reserves the right to cancel any ticket, or reser-
vation, before passage, or enroute,
any time such action is advisable.
The
company accepts no legal responsibility for such action.
Baggage--Thirty-five pounds will be carried free on each full fare ticket.
Charge of one-half of one percent of fare per pound is made on excess
up to 50 pounds.
Baggage weighing over 50 pounds carried only by special
arrangement.
Refunds—If completion of flight is prevented by weather, or other condi-
tions,
refund check covering
the unused portion of the fare is issued
immediately.
These checks may be cashed at all points along the line.
Stopover Privilege-Stopovers are permitted on both one way and round trip
tickets.
Reservations for continuation of flight must be made by passenger.

aloft, comprise NPA passenger service.
VACATION-PLANNING TIPS.
Vacation-planning time is here! National Parks Airways offers a few
vacation suggestions:-
Plan to FLY TO YELLOWSTONE PARK: During the season, National
Parks Airways will resume its flight service to West Yellowstone,
air gateway to the Park..
Via NPA and connecting carriers,
Yellowstone Park will be overnight from practically every important
American city.
